mainRoof.notes: Multi-hip roof. The main body is almost pyramidal with a very short top ridge (about 1 m, parallel to the front); a lower hipped arm runs forward over the garage (ridge front-to-back, hip end facing the front) and another runs back over the roofed terrace at the rear-left (ridge front-to-back, hip end facing the rear), with valleys where the arms meet the main roof. Uniform eaves with white soffit all round.
